harness.selection: first current-v2-strict default-arm finding per development repository

tail_investigation.diagnosis: Profiling attributed the initial tail to repeated contiguous-pair distribution and duplicate location ownership, followed by the compatibility cost of retaining family semantic evidence while also producing target evidence. Pair distribution is now O(members + pairs), locations are not cloned for retained families, prepared changed-site analysis and sibling hashes are cached, and a single identical sibling reuses the family witness. The remaining family-plus-target compatibility path must be collapsed by the v3 policy work in issue 852 before the epic runtime gate can pass.

changes: replace O(groups * pairs) contiguous edge distribution with one member-to-group index
store direct edges as compact family-local indices without cloning retained locations
cache prepared base-to-current changes and sibling node hashes per family
reuse the family semantic witness for the common single-identical-sibling target
cap emitted direct targets at 64 per family
